findings.title: "Required" is documented but not enforced for PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY
findings.explanation: The table says PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KEY is required. src/lib/provider.ts:23 and :42 interpolate it straight into the header. If it is unset, the API starts normally and sends `Authorization: Bearer undefined` to the provider. Either add a startup check that fails fast, or say in the docs that a missing value only shows up as provider auth failures at runtime. The same applies to DATABASE_URL. With it unset, pg silently falls back to the PG* variables or localhost.

findings.title: Default PAYMENT_PROVIDER_URL points to a placeholder host
findings.explanation: The documented default `https://api.payments.example` is a non-resolvable placeholder domain. Say that it is a placeholder and that real environments must override it. Otherwise readers may assume it is a working default. Consider also noting that PORT is parsed with Number(), so a non-numeric value yields NaN.
